|sellprice = 4500 |quality = false }} The '''Void Ghost Pendant''' is an item that can be purchased from the [[Desert Trader]] for 200 [[Void Essence]] after the player has obtained all ten hearts with [[Krobus]]. It can also be dropped by [[monsters]] in the [[Skull Cavern]] and [[Quarry Mine]]. It allows the player to invite [[Krobus]] to move into their house as a roommate, similar to how the [[Mermaid's Pendant]] is used to propose [[marriage]]. However, unlike the Mermaid's Pendant, multiples can be obtained at a time. If given to anyone other than Krobus, it is a hated gift. ==Notes== *The Void Ghost Pendant is impossible to obtain if the player is already married or engaged to one of the marriage candidates. *After purchasing the Pendant and moving Krobus in, the [[Old Mariner]] will respond "Glad the Amulet worked out for ye, lad/miss." when spoken to. ==History== {{History|1.4|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4.4|Can no longer be gifted at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].}} {{History|1.5|Corrected spelling in description.}} {{History|1.6|Multiple pendants can be obtained.}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Schattengeist Amulett]] [[es:Colgante de fantasma del vacío]] [[fr:Pendentif spectral du Vide]] [[it:Ciondolo di uno Spettro del Vuoto]] [[ja:ボイドゴーストペンダント]] [[ko:공허 유령 펜던트]] [[hu:Űr szellem talizmán]] [[pt:Pingente de Fantasma Nulo]] [[ru:Кулон призрачной пустоты]] [[tr:Boşluk Hayaleti'nin Kolyesi]] [[zh:虚空幽灵吊坠]]
